removed_rules.reason: Retired during Agent Skills rule consolidation after the same field-shape guidance moved under AS-002, AS-004, AS-005, and AS-006.
Retired when trigger guidance became part of the description-quality checks instead of a standalone rule.
Retired when cross-platform path checks moved out of Agent Skills and into the XP rule family.

Claude Code permits a user-typed inline /skill-name mention to authorize model invocation even when user-invocable is false and disable-model-invocation is true. The combination is reachable; removing the invocation guard would weaken permission control.
Claude Code documents no limit on dynamic injections.
Claude Code appends invocation arguments when no placeholder receives them.
CC-HK-018 covers documented ignored matchers. Unknown events belong to CC-HK-001.
Claude Code memory docs explicitly import @package.json: @ syntax is documented for README, package.json, and workflow guides, not only .md files.
OpenCode config docs, rules docs, and config.json do not document CONTEXT.md or treat an instructions entry named CONTEXT.md as deprecated.
Duplicate generic-instruction advice is covered by PE-005; removing entire prose lines is not a mechanical repair.
Duplicate negative-instruction advice is covered by PE-006; negative wording does not make a memory file invalid.
Duplicate content-placement advice is covered by PE-001 and is not a loader constraint.
Nested AGENTS.md files are a documented instruction hierarchy, not a configuration defect requiring cross-references.
The MCP Tool schema does not require requiresApproval or confirmation fields. Client-side consent recommendations cannot be validated by inventing tool-definition fields.
The Agent Skills spec says nothing about grammatical person in descriptions, and its description guidance recommends second-person imperative phrasing.
The Agent Skills spec defines only the name format, so vague names were an agnix heuristic rather than a validated constraint.
Claude Code documents that a skill with context: fork and no agent field uses general-purpose, so the rule demanded restating the default.
The Setup hook event is not deprecated: Claude Code documents it as a current event for --init-only and --init or --maintenance in -p mode.
The 100,000-byte AGENTS.md limit had no source. XP-007 checks AGENTS.md against Codex's documented 32 KiB project_doc_max_bytes default, and XP-009 checks the combined chain.
